label: Gödel's 1970 theorem Th3: at every world, if possibly an existing individual is GOD_LIKE_6, then…
paraphrase: Gödel's 1970 theorem Th3 (AFP GoedelVariantHOML1.thy): at every world, if possibly an existing individual is God-like, then necessarily an existing individual is God-like. The antecedent is not derived in the theory.
